messages:
lee_sales: FYI — Crestline Capital returned the SIG and specifically flagged questions 6-9 for evidence. They want attachments and brief plain-language answers by the end of week. Can we divvy up?

amy_se: I'll take Q6 (authentication) and Q9 (privileged access). Need an excerpt of our IAM policy and a short example role binding.

ravi_security: I'll take Q7 (vulnerability management) and Q8 (patching/secure config). I can attach the latest vulnerability scan summary and our patch cadence note.

karen_ps: I'll pull SOC2 controls excerpt and a sanitized runbook snippet showing incident escalation. Also will include a screenshot of our vulnerability dashboard.

uploadbot: File uploaded: <https://files.redwood.internal/iam_policy_excerpt.pdf|iam_policy_excerpt.pdf> (210KB)

amy_se: For role binding example, should we use our platform RBAC or cloud IAM sample? Crestline expects cloud IAM. I'll paste a redacted JSON sample:
```json
{
  "role": "rwinf.admin",
  "principals": ["service:ingest@redwood.internal"],
  "permissions": ["write:models","read:logs"]
}
```

lee_sales: Cloud IAM is fine. Keep principals redacted.

ravi_security: Uploaded vuln scan summary and patch cadence doc: <https://files.redwood.internal/vuln_summary_2026.pdf|vuln_summary_2026.pdf>, <https://files.redwood.internal/patch_cadence.md|patch_cadence.md>

karen_ps: Uploaded SOC2 excerpt and screenshot: <https://files.redwood.internal/soc2_controls_crestline.pdf|soc2_controls_crestline.pdf>, <https://files.redwood.internal/vuln_dashboard_crestline.png|vuln_dashboard_crestline.png>

lee_sales: Please drop final filenames and a 1-2 sentence plain English blurb per question to paste in the SIG. I want to send the bundle tomorrow morning.

amy_se: Filenames: `/shared/sales-crestline/iam_policy_excerpt.pdf`, `/shared/sales-crestline/cloud_role_sample.json`

amy_se: Plain English (Q6): "We integrate with the customer's identity provider for SSO; platform roles limit access to services and are applied with least privilege."

ravi_security: Filenames: `/shared/sales-crestline/vuln_scan_summary.pdf`, `/shared/sales-crestline/patch_cadence.md`

ravi_security: Plain English (Q7/Q8): "We run scheduled vulnerability scans and apply automated patching per a documented cadence; critical fixes are prioritized and hotpatched when needed."

karen_ps: Filenames: `/shared/sales-crestline/soc2_controls.pdf`, `/shared/sales-crestline/vuln_dashboard.png`

karen_ps: Plain English (incident runbook): "The runbook outlines escalation to on-call SREs and customer-notification timelines; screenshot shows the dashboard used for tracking findings."

lee_sales: Awesome. Two small items: 1) ensure the cloud role sample hides account IDs, 2) add a short note in the vuln summary about the scan scope (prod vs staging).

amy_se: Will redact account IDs.

ravi_security: Added scan scope note: "Scope: production control plane and serving fleet (no customer data exfiltration)"

lee_sales: Thanks everyone — packaging now. I'll upload final ZIP to `/shared/sales-crestline/final_bundle.zip` and send to Crestline tomorrow AM.
